en: fade back into wildfires office for now, if we can have her desk blown in two that would be cool, she's standing in front of it now, one guard is facing her the guard captain is blasted and ko'ed against the wallon the other end of the room.
Haaaaah...haaaah...
Alright, I'm calm, I'm calm.
I'M FUCKING CALM!
Deep breaths, I'm calm. I'm calm.
Okay...so, where did we leave off?
Uhhhh...
Oh, that's right. That incompetent idiot of a superior officer of yours explained to me that there was an uprising that wasn't put down.
Given that I'm not an idiot, I can also assume that the fact that the town feels empty is because the resistance managed to recruit a significant amount of our people right beneath your noses.
Uhh...ma'am, if I may...we sent a significant amount of men to handle the matter, but they were all defeated. We've basically used half the city's garrison and still lost.
I suppose that also explains why there's so many fucking people crowding our care facilities at the momennt. Unnaceptable! Fucking unnaceptable!

What I'm more confused about is how you managed to fucking lose to those people. How?! You know, I've fought them before myself. They're strong, but they're definitely not fucking strong enough to fight half the garrison.
It's those four again, right? How I'd love to melt that heap of scrap metal and then pour his remains over that stuttering old fool and that little bitch with the guns!
And that leader of theirs...oh how I wish I could finish what I fucking started with her...
But I'm getting fucking carried away with pointless sentimentality! You've still yet to explain why those four gave you such a hard time!
Well, you see ma'am...it wasn't really them that led the attack...
Huh?! Are you even more fucking stupid than I initially thought?!
Don't tell me a bunch of grunts managed to incapacitate half of our fucking garrison!
W-Well! If it makes you feel better it wasn't a bunch of grunts, or the four leaders of the resistance! We lost to a much more powerful opponent!
Yeah! It was that ex-airship hero, Jenna Wright! She just showed up and she started taking out wave after wave of our reinforcements! We didn't stand a chance against her!

We were totally outmatched! I mean, she's really strong! Like, REALLY STRONG. And she's really nimble, and agile and she's got all these weird techniques we're not used to dealing with! I mean, she's amazing!
fade to black
back to overworld with the two guards outside the hq
You're being serious?! This isn't the first time she's done this?!
Hell no! They don't call her 'Wildfire' for nothing. Once she gets pissed, she starts blowing smoke out of her shoulders and then it's not long before she starts blasting.
And when she starts blasting, dear God she can't tell friend from foe. Either that or she's so bloodthirsty everyone's a foe at that point.
My point is, if you wanna survive around here, when there's bad news you best make sure you're not the one to deliver them to her.
Damn...that sounds rou-Wait a minute...is it getting hot again?
Oh boy. So soon? Yeah, you better cover your ears for this one.
screenshake, explosions, thuds, etc
JENNAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!
more explosions and more screenshakes
RAAAAARGH! BITCH! WHORE! I HATE YOU! DIE!
even more explosions, sound of an alarm, then a water sprinkler can be heard raining down on her
Oh no...
What is it now?!
Ever since Commander Wildfire moved in, we forgot to remove the-
GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH! WHO THE FUCK PUT A WATER SPRINKLER IN MY ROOM!?
I'LL KILL YOU! ALL OF YOU! I'LL FUCKING BURN THIS ENTIRE TOWN TO ASH! TURN IT OFF! TURN THIS FUCKING WATER SPRINKLER OFF!
Wha...what do we do n-now?
We wait out here, and we make damn sure we use every excuse we can figure out to not go back inside until she's taken her anger out on people other than us.
Wow...
Welcome to working under Wildfire, kid.
end scene
Where do you want to travel?
Cancel.
HQ happy to see Jenna!
Leave.
Talk to him.
Hey Henry, how are you doing?
HQ good, HQ like place.
HQ talk lot with shiny foil guy.
Glad you get along with them.
Just wanted to check on you.
See ya later buddy.
Just you wait until you see what I've got cooking for my next escape room!
Hmmm... No broken bones yet... Maybe I should check again! This might take a while.
When I said I had a bone for you... I meant... nevermind...
Guess ol Ray gotta thank ye' for helpin' 'em figure out wha' th' boys (an' girls) really be wantin'. So... Thank ye'.
No shred clothes... No shred clothes... Maybe shred clothes a little.
Look how pretty my plants are! I watered them myself! Don't ask what with...
Is this a... stripper pole?
Mmhm~ Let's take it home.
I like the sound of that~
Really? This is what we fought those soldiers for?
I think it's well worth it~ And they even built a nice little tent for it~ I wanna see blue put this to use~
Eheh!
Is this a cross?
Looks like it's been through a bit of use.
Maybe we should put it through a bit more use.
Oooor maybe we should get these supplies back to the mansion.
Well would you look at that, they really did a number on this place with the resources we got for them.
They've basically turned the place into a sex dungeon.
My kinda room.
Man the Carcens would've killed to have something like this back in the town hall. We wouldn't have been able to keep them in check.
So many...interesting pieces of equipment around here. Wouldn't you all agree?
You can say that again. I got my eyes on the cross. We should give it a proper look. Maybe even take it for a spin, eh Jenna?
Rida wanna try too!
(It's snowing out! How wonderful!)
(But why isn't anyone showing any holiday cheer? I better ask Klaus about this...)
(Phew! Looks like that's all that was in the bag!)
(Hang on... There's actually something else in here... The tailor must've put it in here for me!)
I need a bag full of festive holiday hats to hand out to everyone!
Hmm... That'll be costly... Let's say about <color=money>500 fuckbucks</color>.
I don't have that much!
Sorry, hun. Come back when you have enough then.
Finally!
Alright. Got your bag here. It's a bit heavy. I also made you a hat as well. Good luck with your little holiday quest.
Wow! Thanks! How'd you get it all done so fast?
Machine in the back. I'm just a glorified operator, not a real tailor.
Oh! Uh... Well... Spread some hats out to everyone here. You can keep one for yourself too!
Wonderful...
I need a nice bag full of festive hats to give out to everyone!
Hmm... That'll be <color=money>500 fuckbucks</color>.
Alrighty! I've got that right here!
Perfect. It's going to take a little while. Wait here.
(Oh wow! Looks like people are in the holiday spirit now!)
Why isn't anyone celebrating or showing any holiday cheer?
... Celebrate...? What do we have to celebrate?
Well... the holidays of course...
We haven't celebrated anything except sex for the past few years.
Really? That doesn't seem very nice...
This place isn't very nice, but you get used to it, little hero.
Well I'm gonna do something about it!
Uh huh... How exactly do you plan to do that?
Hmm... I'll figure something out, I always do.
Good luck with that, little hero. Although... I could give you a 'white' Christmas if that's what you want.
Uh huh.
(Hmm... Maybe I can head to the gear store to get some festive gifts!)
E-Eh?!
Hey! It fits!
A-Ah! T-Thank you, J-Jenna!
For me? Aw, that's sweet of you.
It looks good on you!
It feels good! Like it's not even there!
Hey! Err... I need some gifts made.
Gifts...? Hm... What do you need?
Well...
Alright... all done. Look good?
Wow! These are awesome! Thank you!
(Now to start handing these out to everyone!)
(I don't have enough fuckbucks...)
What is this...?
It's a gift!
I-Is this a gift?
Of course it is! What do you think?
I... It's... been... Thank you.
(This place is so rundown... I wonder if people even remember that it's the holiday season...)
(Maybe they just need me to spread some holiday cheer! I'll go talk to Lady.)
Hey Lady! What're your plans for celebrating?
Cele...brating...?
What would we be celebrating?
Uhhh... the holidays of course!
... For morale?
(Hmm... I've got a sack of gifts already. Might as well give 'em out to everyone here!)
Errr... Bye!
(Their spirits must be really down in the dumps... There's gotta be something I can do... Maybe I should go to the shopkeeper and get some gifts for people.)
Errr... Bye!
Well actually I just wanted to-
Hush up, wee slag. Ol' Ray ain't be payin' ye any attentions 'til ye best the boys (an' girls) in a fight. Go fight 'em an' then come back when ye've bested each one.
Huh. Thanks for clearly explaining what I should do!
Well actually I just wanted to give you something nice to wear for the holidays!
Y-Y'wot?!
Yeah! I got a bunch of hats that you and your buds can wear if you want to!
Ol' Ray ain't got no interest in no hats! All that ol' Ray an' the boys (an' girls) want be some fresh puss to pummel!
Hmm... Well how about this? If I beat you guys in a fight, will you wear the hats?
Fight? Hmm... Fine. Ol' Ray agrees to this. But y'ain't gonna be beatin' us Rats!
Bring it on! Fighting is the best way to celebrate the holidays!
Phew! Sorry if I went a little hard on you!
Argh... Ol' Ray be fine... Ray an' the boys (an' girls) will wear yer damn hats. Least 'til the holidays be over.
Woo! Ol' Jenna be hopin' ye' like 'em- I mean uh... I hope you like them.
